biotools.summary: MetaBolt is a Nextflow-based automated pipeline designed for the rapid recovery of metagenome-assembled genomes (MAGs) from short-read metagenomic datasets. It improves efficiency by optimizing the crucial de novo assembly step, providing a streamlined solution for metagenome-resolved metagenomics.
